16	const SUMMARY_TEMPLATE = `Output exactly the Markdown structure shown inside <template> and keep the section order unchanged. Do not include the <template> tags in your response.
17	<template>
18	## Objective
19	- [one or two brief sentences describing what the user is trying to accomplish]
20	
21	## Important Details
22	- [constraints/preferences, decisions and why, important facts/assumptions, exact context needed to continue, or "(none)"]
23	
24	## Work State
25	### Completed
26	- [finished work, verified facts, or changes made; otherwise "(none)"]
27	
28	### Active
29	- [current work, partial changes, or investigation state; otherwise "(none)"]
30	
31	### Blocked
32	- [blockers, failing commands, or unknowns; otherwise "(none)"]
33	
34	## Next Move
35	1. [immediate concrete action, or "(none)"]
36	2. [next action if known, or "(none)"]
37	
38	## Relevant Files
39	- [file or directory path: why it matters, or "(none)"]
40	</template>
41	
42	Rules:
43	- Keep every section, even when empty.
44	- Use terse bullets, not prose paragraphs.
45	- Preserve exact file paths, symbols, commands, error strings, URLs, and identifiers when known.
46	- Do not mention the summary process or that context was compacted.`
47	const SUMMARY_UPDATE_INSTRUCTIONS = `The <prior-summary> summarizes everything that happened before the <conversation>. Construct a new summary that combines both. The <prior-summary> is discarded after this: anything you do not carry into the new summary is lost.
48	
49	When combining:
50	- Carry forward objectives, constraints, user directives, decisions, and parallel workstreams from the <prior-summary> even when the <conversation> does not mention them. Drop only what is finished and no longer needed.
51	- The <conversation> is more recent than the <prior-summary>. Where they conflict, the conversation wins: state the corrected fact and drop the old claim.
52	- Add new progress, decisions, constraints, and context from the conversation.
53	- Move completed work from "Active" to "Completed".
54	- If a blocker has been resolved, update the summary to reflect that while keeping any details still needed to continue the work.
55	- Update "Objective" and "Next Move" to reflect the current work state.`

88	export const serializeToolContent = (content: SessionMessage.ToolStateCompleted["content"]) =>
89	  content

91	      item.type === "text" ? item.text : `[Attached ${item.mime}${item.name === undefined ? "" : `: ${item.name}`}]`,

95	const serialize = (message: SessionMessage.Message) => {
96	  if (message.type === "user") {
97	    const files = message.files?.map((file) => `[Attached ${file.mime}: ${file.name ?? file.uri}]`) ?? []
98	    return [`[User]: ${message.text}`, ...files].join("\n")
99	  }
100	  if (message.type === "assistant") {
101	    return message.content
102	      .flatMap((part) => {
103	        if (part.type === "text") return [`[Assistant]: ${part.text}`]
104	        if (part.type === "reasoning") return part.text ? [`[Assistant reasoning]: ${part.text}`] : []
105	        const input = typeof part.state.input === "string" ? part.state.input : JSON.stringify(part.state.input)
106	        if (part.state.status === "completed")
107	          return [
108	            `[Assistant tool call]: ${part.name}(${input})`,
109	            `[Tool result]: ${truncate(serializeToolContent(part.state.content))}`,
110	          ]
111	        if (part.state.status === "error")
112	          return [`[Assistant tool call]: ${part.name}(${input})`, `[Tool error]: ${part.state.error.message}`]
113	        return [`[Assistant tool call]: ${part.name}(${input})`]
114	      })
115	      .join("\n")
116	  }
117	  if (message.type === "system") return `[System update]: ${message.text}`
118	  if (message.type === "synthetic") return `[Synthetic context]: ${message.text}`
119	  if (message.type === "shell") return `[Shell]: ${message.command}\n${truncate(message.output)}`
120	  return ""
121	}

123	const settings = (documents: readonly Config.Entry[]) => {
124	  const configured = documents
125	    .filter((entry): entry is Config.Document => entry.type === "document")
126	    .flatMap((entry) => (entry.info.compaction ? [entry.info.compaction] : []))
127	  return configured.reduce<Settings>(
128	    (result, current) => ({
129	      auto: current.auto ?? result.auto,
130	      buffer: current.buffer ?? result.buffer,
131	      tokens: current.keep?.tokens ?? result.tokens,
132	    }),
133	    { auto: true, buffer: DEFAULT_BUFFER, tokens: DEFAULT_KEEP_TOKENS },
134	  )

137	const select = (
138	  entries: readonly Entry[],
139	  tokens: number,
140	): { readonly head: string; readonly recent: string } | undefined => {
141	  const conversation = entries
142	    .filter((entry) => entry.message.type !== "compaction")
143	    .map((entry) => serialize(entry.message))
144	    .filter(Boolean)
145	  if (conversation.length === 0) return
146	  let total = 0
147	  let split = conversation.length
148	  for (let index = conversation.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
149	    const next = total + Token.estimate(conversation[index])
150	    if (next > tokens) break
151	    total = next
152	    split = index
153	  }
154	  return {
155	    head: conversation.slice(0, split).join("\n\n"),
156	    recent: conversation.slice(split).join("\n\n"),
157	  }
158	}

160	export const buildPrompt = (input: { readonly previousSummary?: string; readonly context: readonly string[] }) => {
161	  const conversation = `Here is the conversation so far:\n\n<conversation>\n${input.context.join("\n\n")}\n</conversation>`
162	  if (!input.previousSummary)
163	    return [
164	      conversation,
165	      "Create a new anchored summary from the conversation history in the <conversation> tags above so another coding agent can continue the work.",
166	      SUMMARY_TEMPLATE,
167	    ].join("\n\n")
168	  return [
169	    conversation,
170	    `Here is the summary of the conversation before the <conversation> above:\n\n<prior-summary>\n${input.previousSummary}\n</prior-summary>`,
171	    SUMMARY_UPDATE_INSTRUCTIONS,
172	    SUMMARY_TEMPLATE,
173	  ].join("\n\n")
174	}

176	export const make = (dependencies: Dependencies) => {
177	  const config = settings(dependencies.config)
178	  const compactAfterOverflow = Effect.fn("SessionCompaction.compactAfterOverflow")(function* (input: Input) {
179	    const context = input.model.route.defaults.limits?.context
180	    if (context === undefined || context <= 0) return false
181	    const output = input.request.generation?.maxTokens ?? input.model.route.defaults.limits?.output ?? 0
182	    const selected = select(input.entries, config.tokens)
183	    const previousSummary = input.entries.find((entry) => entry.message.type === "compaction")?.message
184	    if (!selected || (selected.head.length === 0 && previousSummary?.type !== "compaction")) return false
185	    const summaryPrompt = buildPrompt({
186	      previousSummary: previousSummary?.type === "compaction" ? previousSummary.summary : undefined,
187	      context: [previousSummary?.type === "compaction" ? previousSummary.recent : "", selected.head].filter(Boolean),
188	    })
189	    const summaryOutput = Math.min(output || SUMMARY_OUTPUT_TOKENS, SUMMARY_OUTPUT_TOKENS)
190	    if (Token.estimate(summaryPrompt) > context - summaryOutput) return false
191	    const messageID = SessionMessage.ID.create()
192	    yield* dependencies.events.publish(SessionEvent.Compaction.Started, {
193	      sessionID: input.sessionID,
194	      messageID,
195	      timestamp: yield* DateTime.now,
196	      reason: "auto",
197	    })
198	
199	    const chunks: string[] = []
200	    let failed = false
201	    const summarized = yield* dependencies.llm
202	      .stream(
203	        LLM.request({
204	          model: input.model,
205	          http: input.request.http,
206	          messages: [Message.user(summaryPrompt)],
207	          tools: [],
208	          generation: { maxTokens: summaryOutput },
209	        }),
210	      )
211	      .pipe(
212	        Stream.runForEach((event) => {
213	          if (LLMEvent.is.providerError(event)) failed = true
214	          if (LLMEvent.is.textDelta(event)) chunks.push(event.text)
215	          return Effect.void
216	        }),
217	        Effect.as(true),
218	        Effect.catchTag("LLM.Error", () => Effect.succeed(false)),
219	      )
220	    const summary = chunks.join("")
221	    if (!summarized || failed || !summary.trim()) return false
222	    yield* dependencies.events.publish(SessionEvent.Compaction.Ended, {
223	      sessionID: input.sessionID,
224	      messageID,
225	      timestamp: yield* DateTime.now,
226	      reason: "auto",
227	      text: summary,
228	      recent: selected.recent,
229	    })
230	    return true
231	  })
232	  const compactIfNeeded = Effect.fn("SessionCompaction.compactIfNeeded")(function* (input: Input) {
233	    if (!config.auto) return false
234	    const context = input.model.route.defaults.limits?.context
235	    if (context === undefined || context <= 0) return false
236	    const output = input.request.generation?.maxTokens ?? input.model.route.defaults.limits?.output ?? 0
237	    if (
238	      estimate({ system: input.request.system, messages: input.request.messages, tools: input.request.tools }) <=
239	      context - Math.max(output, config.buffer)
240	    )
241	      return false
242	    return yield* compactAfterOverflow(input)
243	  })
244	  return {
245	    compactIfNeeded,
246	    compactAfterOverflow,
247	  }
248	}

525	export function filterCompacted(msgs: Iterable<WithParts>) {
526	  const result = [] as WithParts[]
527	  const completed = new Set<string>()
528	  let retain: MessageID | undefined
529	  for (const msg of msgs) {
530	    result.push(msg)
531	    if (retain) {
532	      if (msg.info.id === retain) break
533	      continue
534	    }
535	    if (msg.info.role === "user" && completed.has(msg.info.id)) {
536	      const part = msg.parts.find((item): item is CompactionPart => item.type === "compaction")
537	      if (!part) continue
538	      if (!part.tail_start_id) break
539	      retain = part.tail_start_id
540	      if (msg.info.id === retain) break
541	      continue
542	    }
543	    if (msg.info.role === "user" && completed.has(msg.info.id) && msg.parts.some((part) => part.type === "compaction"))
544	      break
545	    if (msg.info.role === "assistant" && msg.info.summary && msg.info.finish && !msg.info.error)
546	      completed.add(msg.info.parentID)
547	  }
548	  result.reverse()
549	  const compactionIndex = result.findLastIndex(
550	    (msg) =>
551	      msg.info.role === "user" &&
552	      msg.parts.some((item): item is CompactionPart => item.type === "compaction" && item.tail_start_id !== undefined),
553	  )
554	  const compaction = result[compactionIndex]
555	  const part = compaction?.parts.find(
556	    (item): item is CompactionPart => item.type === "compaction" && item.tail_start_id !== undefined,
557	  )
558	  const summaryIndex = compaction
559	    ? result.findIndex(
560	        (msg, index) =>
561	          index > compactionIndex &&
562	          msg.info.role === "assistant" &&
563	          msg.info.summary &&
564	          msg.info.parentID === compaction.info.id,
565	      )
566	    : -1
567	  const tailIndex = part?.tail_start_id ? result.findIndex((msg) => msg.info.id === part.tail_start_id) : -1
568	  if (tailIndex >= 0 && tailIndex < compactionIndex && summaryIndex > compactionIndex) {
569	    return [
570	      ...result.slice(compactionIndex, summaryIndex + 1),
571	      ...result.slice(tailIndex, compactionIndex),
572	      ...result.slice(summaryIndex + 1),
573	    ]
574	  }
575	  return result
576	}
